system.description:
You are able to counter Grab and Grapple attacks, redirecting them back on your attacker.

Prerequisite: Dexterity 13

Effect: You gain a +2 bonus to your Reflex Defense against Grab and Grapple attacks. If an enemy misses you when making a Grab or Grapple attack, you can immediately make your own Grab attack against the same enemy as a Reaction.

Special: If you have a Feat that enables you to make a Grapple attack (such as Pin or Trip), you can make a Grapple attack instead.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Unknown Regions
